warningFor: Central Haldane County in southwestern Ohio...
Northern Marlow County in southwestern Ohio...
fields.at: At 213 PM EDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3.5 inches of rain have fallen in the last two hours. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly. Cedar Ridge Reservoir is near its spillway crest.
fields.impact: Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor drainage and low-lying areas.
actions: Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood deaths occur in vehicles.
Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the dangers of flooding.
